messages:
Alex (AE): Hey team — prepping Acme Corp POC kickoff. Need a short onboarding checklist + runbook for provisioning today: Hosted API key, short-lived Dedicated pool access, and optional Private/VPC. Who can own the flow and share exact steps/commands?

Maya (SE): I can own. Draft checklist below, feel free to copy into the customer ticket. I kept it minimal for a 1-week POC.

Maya (SE): 1) Confirm model + token budget (e.g., gpt-4x-8k q4/8k). 2) Decide deployment mode: HOSTED / DEDICATED / PRIVATE. 3) For HOSTED: create scoped API key (read/generate/embeddings) + tag "acme-poc". 4) For DEDICATED: request pool with GPUs (NVIDIA A10x2) for baseline throughput, TTL 7d, add autoscale guardrails. 5) For PRIVATE: open VPC peering ticket + KMS key policy, share subnet CIDRs and egress rules. 6) Run smoke tests (sample prompt set) and share logs. 7) Add POC quota & billing guardrails.

Maya (SE): Hosted key example (internal CLI snippet):
```
redwood keys create --name "acme-poc-hosted" --scopes generation,embeddings --expires 7d --tags acme,poc
```

Maya (SE): Smoke test curl (hosted):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-4x","input":"test"}'
```

Ivan (Infra): For Dedicated I'll need: customer name, desired start/end, qps target, model family, region, and whether network egress must be restricted. I'll spin up ephemeral pool and attach a short-lived service account. Sample infra request body we use in tickets: 
```
{
  "customer":"Acme Corp",
  "env":"poc",
  "pool_size":2,
  "gpu_type":"a10x",
  "start":"2026-03-25T10:00Z",
  "end":"2026-04-01T10:00Z",
  "region":"us-west-2"
}
```

Ivan (Infra): I'll also attach a per-pool prometheus scrape and baseline latency SLO so we can rollback.

Priya (Security): Quick security checklist to include in the ticket: data classification, retention window, encryption at rest (KMS ARN), TLS enforced, IP allowlist for Private, SOC2 + PCI notes if requested. For questionnaires, we provide a canned POC security appendix — I'll attach it.

Priya (Security): If they ask about logs: we redact PII by default in logs for hosted POCs; for Private, we can keep raw logs behind customer network. Need to confirm retention period.

Sam (Sales Ops): What's the standard POC credit & pricing guidance? Acme asked about cost caps.

Maya (SE): Default: $2k trial credits for outbound-hosted usage; Dedicated billed as reserved daily rate + overage at list. For a 1-week small POC we usually set a $1k spend cap and alert at 80%. I can add cost alarms to the customer route.

Alex (AE): Great — can you add the exact wording I should put in the customer onboarding packet? Need something to send after kickoff call.

Maya (SE): Short template you can paste: 
"Next steps to get your POC running:
- Confirm model & token budget
- Provide desired dates + qps target
- Provide network CIDRs if you want Private/VPC
- Approve short-lived API key or Dedicated request
- Run provided smoke tests and review results
We will provision within 24 hours of approval and send access details and a smoke-test report."

Ivan (Infra): I've created infra ticket #IR-4127 for the Dedicated pool request and linked a provisioning checklist. ETA: 6-8 hours once we have model + qps.

deploy-bot: Provisioning ticket IR-4127 created by Ivan (Infra) — status: open.

Sam (Sales Ops): I'll set the spend cap in billing and add an 80% usage alert. Please tag me on the final ticket so I can approve credits.

Priya (Security): I've uploaded the POC security appendix to the ticket and added suggested answers for the customer's questionnaire (data flows, KMS, retention).

Maya (SE): Final runbook checklist for us internally (short):
- Owner: Maya (SE)
- Hosted key path: create + tag + send to AE (1)
- Dedicated path: open IR ticket + set pool TTL (2)
- Private path: start peering + KMS + test ping (3)
- Smoke tests: run 10 sample prompts, capture latency & token usage (4)
- Close loop: share results and billing guardrails (5)

Alex (AE): Perfect. I'm sending kickoff email now. Tag me when the hosted key or ticket is ready. :thumbsup:

Maya (SE): Copy — will post the hosted key once created and drop the smoke test results here.

Ivan (Infra): Will update IR-4127 with pool details as soon as nodes are up.

Alex (AE): Thanks all — moving to customer call.
